lines.say: 7.1 seconds. / That is how long / this AI agent needs / to search flights / from Zürich to London.
It is Jev Ultrafast, / a browser agent / from Browser Use. / Give it one goal, / and it does the clicking.
Every page becomes / a numbered table / of buttons and fields.
One request picks / the move and the target: / click element 7, / or type into field 3. / A small model / writes the text.
Two decisions, / one network round trip, / and no screenshots / in the loop.
Against the previous version, / median task time / fell 25%, / and browser calls / dropped from 1,092 / to 101.

bars.note: median browser protocol calls · 3 runs each

lines.say: The same agent opened / a Wikipedia article / in 2.8 seconds, / and a hotel search / in 1.9.
The model never writes / selectors, coordinates / or JavaScript. / Every click is checked / against the live page.
It is an MVP, / and says so: / frames, canvas and uploads / are still out of reach.
Clone it, / add two API keys, / and start the demo.
Send this / to someone / who still clicks / through flight searches.
Jev Ultrafast. / One request / per decision.
